validation.reason: Schema validation and local production-renderer planning passed with a syntactically valid operator-supplied immutable image; neither check pulls or qualifies that image.

task_fidelity.reason: The workflow now requires an operator-supplied immutable runtime image. Its source-overlay, renderer, inputs, and outputs require fresh workload qualification together.

output_storage.reason: No current run with the operator-supplied runtime image has completed immutable publication or independent object-storage readback.

worker_input.reason: No current worker run has executed the source overlay and authored scene modules with the operator-supplied runtime image.

credentials.reason: Current project, storage, image-pull, and worker credentials require a fresh preflight for the selected operator runtime image.

source_image.reason: The workflow intentionally has no default runtime image. A compatible immutable NPA image must be supplied by the operator and independently qualified.

target_runtime.reason: The selected operator runtime image requires fresh native RTX OptiX workload qualification on the target before this claim can be verified.
